zh: 输出顺序分两个阶段：先按收藏列表顺序给出所有收藏，再按原列表顺序给出所有未收藏的图片，之后一直是 NULL。
只需要一个收藏集合和两个游标：第一阶段推进收藏游标；第二阶段推进原列表游标，并跳过收藏集合里的图片。游标只向前走，不会重复输出。
把收藏标识放进哈希集合；对 q 次调用：若收藏游标未走完就输出下一个收藏；否则把原列表游标跳过所有收藏项，若还有图片则输出并前进，否则输出 NULL；结果用空格连接输出。
en: The output has two phases: first all favourites in favourite-list order, then all non-favourite images in original order, and NULL after that.

You only need a set of favourites and two cursors: phase one advances the favourite cursor; phase two advances the cursor over the original list and skips images in the favourite set. Cursors only move forward, so nothing is returned twice.

Put the favourite ids in a hash set; for each of the q calls: if the favourite cursor is not exhausted, output the next favourite; otherwise move the original-list cursor past favourites, output the next image and advance if one exists, or output NULL; print the results separated by spaces.

explanationEn:
## Approach

At construction time only build the set of favourites and keep two cursors. First advance the favourite cursor; after that, scan the original list skipping favourites, and output NULL once everything is exhausted.

## Correctness

The first phase outputs exactly all favourites in favourite order. The second phase scans in the original order; the set check excludes every favourite that was already output, and every non-favourite is output once. Because the cursors only move forward, later calls never repeat an image or go out of bounds.

## Complexity

Construction O(m), all q calls together O(n + m + q), extra space O(m) (not counting input and output).
